description: The integer pairs \((0,1)\) and \((0,2)\) satisfy the same atomic equality and strict-order formulas.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.QuantifierElimination.integer_pairs_same_shared_atomic_formulas :
  have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure ℤ fun a b => a < b;
  ∀ (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.binaryRelLanguage.BoundedFormula Empty 2),
    φ.IsAtomic → (φ.Realize Empty.elim ![0, 1] ↔ φ.Realize Empty.elim ![0, 2])
